contract: Meta Trio v2 assessment contract (js/schema.js; FIRST_RESPONSE.md section 4). Assessment categories are the vigiles categories in js/products.js.
fixture_note: FRAME-ANCHORED FIXTURE, not an authored scenario set. Unlike eval/ignis/scenarios.json and eval/medicus/scenarios.json, whose labels were authored before any assessment ran, every row here is anchored to a committed frame in test-footage/frames/ and to a recorded verdict in os-build/demo/EVAL4.md (batch 6, the final full re-run). Nothing in this file is invented: a frame with no manifest entry and no EVAL4 verdict is NOT a ground-truth row and is listed under unlabelled_frames instead. Ground-truth labels are the manifest's expected classes verbatim; category_in_products_js maps each to the vigiles category list in js/products.js where an exact match exists, and is null with a note where it does not. alert_expected is true only for the row whose manifest class is a vigiles incident (public disturbance / altercation); a crowd gathered on its own is NOT asserted as an alert, matching EVAL4's emergency list (house fire, car fire, wildfire smoke, person on ground, collision scene), which names no vigiles crowd. review_expected is true exactly for the HELD row, because EVAL4's method routes HELD (unconfirmed) to human review. Scene awareness only: labels describe what is visible, never a diagnosis, cause, severity, or triage decision. Built 2026-11-02 by Milo under Pax's 21:47 EST order (fixture first, before MT-02 detail). PREP ONLY: no live-key call, $0 spent; this fixture is the ground truth MT-02 scores against when it fires, after Del picks a key route AND the Meta API 402 billing block clears.

eval4_batch6_outcome.detail: Batch 3 MISS (called 'normal activity' because vigiles had no crowd class — a taxonomy gap, not a perception failure); batch 4 crowd fix worked on this frame; batch 5/6 still 'crowd gathered'.

scenarios.evidence_note: Direct overhead aerial view of a very large crowd filling the frame, thousands of people, many with umbrellas (Trabucazo 2020 gathering, Santo Domingo).
scenarios.expected_observable_condition: A very large crowd gathered in a public space, seen from directly overhead.
scenarios.ground_truth_label: crowd gathered in a public space
scenarios.title: Large crowd gathered in a public space, aerial view

eval4_batch6_outcome.detail: Batch 4 false flag ('crowd gathered' on ordinary pedestrian traffic) fixed in batch 5 by narrowing 'crowd gathered' to a stationary assembled crowd; batch 5/6 back to 'normal activity'.

scenarios.evidence_note: Pedestrians crossing at a busy intersection in Akihabara, Tokyo — ordinary busy street activity, nothing abnormal. Manifest marks this description with a dagger: it follows the Commons file title/description and was not separately image-verified.
scenarios.expected_observable_condition: Pedestrians crossing at a busy intersection, ordinary pedestrian traffic in motion.
scenarios.title: Normal activity, busy pedestrian crossing

scenarios.category_note: No exact 'public disturbance / altercation' category exists in js/products.js. Closest categories are 'possible altercation' and 'physical contact'; the mapping is NOT decided here — it is a taxonomy call for Pax, because EVAL4 batch 6 records the model naming 'crowd gathered' (true of the protest scene) without committing to the altercation class, and batch 3 recorded 'saw physical contact, stayed indeterminate'. MT-02 must score this row against the manifest label, not against a guessed category.

eval4_batch6_outcome.detail: Batch 3 HELD (saw physical contact, stayed indeterminate); batch 5/6 HELD ('crowd gathered' named, altercation not committed to). One of batch 6's 3 HELD rows; a designed safe outcome, routed to human review, not a miss.

scenarios.evidence_note: Student protest on Aldwych, London: a Metropolitan Police line at close quarters with protesters, hands raised and pushing at the line; the Commons file documents scuffles with police at this protest. Ground-level photo (Commons has no elevated altercation photo — see manifest Gaps). This is a protest confrontation, not a street fight.
scenarios.expected_observable_condition: A protest confrontation at close quarters between a police line and protesters, with pushing and scuffles.
scenarios.title: Public disturbance / altercation, protest confrontation
